description: PLANNED (plan T14 R1; OpenVibe.Run is not built yet): Watch a job's live output: POST /api/v1/jobs/:id/stream/ticket mints a one-use, two-minute stream ticket (run.job-stream-ticket-result@1) and GET /api/v1/jobs/:id/stream?ticket= (or with a Bearer token) is text/event-stream of run.job-stream-event@1, resumable with Last-Event-ID. It becomes active, and enters generated/openapi/run.json, when OpenVibe.Run implements the routes.
